description: Palletizing task plan for the UR10e. Boxes appear one after another at their start position (like the MathWorks example) and are placed at their goal, in the order listed.
units: lengths in meters, weight in kilograms
frame: world frame = simulation frame: origin on the floor directly under the robot base, x/y horizontal, z up
position_reference: x, y = centre of the box bottom face; z = height of the box bottom face
spawning: box 1 is on the conveyor at the start; each next box appears at its start position when the previous box has been placed on the pallet
conveyor: static (belt does not move); boxes appear resting on its top surface at z = 0.50
pallet: Euro pallet, top surface at z = 0.144
